company.description:
Entravel is a blockchain-powered travel and hospitality platform redefining global hotel booking through a crypto-native ecosystem. Designed for modern travelers and cryptocurrency users, Entravel provides access to more than one million hotels worldwide while enabling seamless payments using digital assets such as USDC and USDT.

Operating within the competitive online travel industry, Entravel differentiates itself by leveraging blockchain technology and strategic pricing models to offer hotel rates that can be significantly lower than traditional booking platforms. The platform delivers instant booking confirmations, streamlined user experiences, and secure crypto transactions tailored for tech-savvy travelers and Web3 communities.

A core component of Entravel’s business model is its invite-only affiliate ecosystem, where users can earn commissions through referrals and tiered partnership benefits. This community-driven structure incentivizes users to promote the platform while unlocking exclusive rewards and travel-related earning opportunities.

By combining scalable booking infrastructure, decentralized payment capabilities, and affiliate-powered growth, Entravel aims to transform the hospitality sector and bridge the gap between travel services and the rapidly evolving blockchain economy.
